tagline: European inland navigation industry representative body and standards organization
hero_kpi_rationale: Record participation at 2024 Annual Congress in Frankfurt with 225 members from 11 European countries demonstrates strong stakeholder engagement and organizational relevance in European inland navigation sector

kpis.name: Annual Congress Participants
kpis.explanation: Total attendees at the 2024 IVR Annual Congress held May 15-17 in Frankfurt
kpis.description: The 2024 IVR Congress in Frankfurt attracted 225 participants from 11 European countries, representing a successful gathering of industry stakeholders in the organization's founding city

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Attendance
kpis.explanation: Total attendees at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium held November 4, 2024 in Antwerp
kpis.description: The inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium on November 4, 2024 in Antwerp attracted approximately 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany, covering technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in European inland navigation

kpis.name: CESNI Committee Meetings
kpis.explanation: Number of European standards standardization committee meetings attended by IVR in observer capacity during 2024
kpis.description: IVR participated as observer in multiple CESNI working group and committee meetings in 2024, including sessions on April 11 and October 17, contributing to European standards development for inland navigation

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Committee Meetings
kpis.explanation: Number of physical meetings held by the Loss Prevention Committee with members present in 2024
kpis.description: The IVR Loss Prevention Committee held 3 in-person meetings during 2024, focusing on technical regulations, prevention challenges, and publication of recommendations for ship owners

ai_positioning.summary: No artificial intelligence positioning or strategy mentioned in the 2024 annual report. The organization focuses on traditional inland navigation governance, standards development, and industry coordination.
